page.overview:
What is Mothim?

Mothim is based on a moth. It has yellow wings with orange on the outer and inner tips. Its antennae are white, with orange on top. Its eyes are orange. Its base body is black, with an orange stripe, and white legs.

Mothim has the Abilities Swarm and Tinted Lens. Its also can be used in Sky Battles. Swarm raises the power of Bug type moves when Mothim's HP is low. Tinted Lens doubles the power of a not very effective move, e.g. if Mothim used Bug Buzz on Jigglypuff.

Mothim evolves from Burmy starting at level 20 and if it is male.

Mothim first appeared in the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl episode, Some Enchanted Sweetening!. He evolved from Cheryl's Burmy and was used to search for the sacred honey.
